title: Email
subtitle: 「電郵／電子郵件／電郵通訊」，要先分清是在談一封訊息、整個通訊媒介、持續往來，還是較廣的數碼書面通訊。
description: 「電郵／電子郵件／電郵通訊」，要先分清是在談一封訊息、整個通訊媒介、持續往來，還是較廣的數碼書面通訊。

words.meaning: 電子郵件；電子郵件系統
words.example: The organisation introduced electronic mail before most staff had internet access at home.
words.exampleZh: 該機構在大部分員工家中尚未有互聯網前便引入電子郵件。

exercises.original: The policy was written before email became the organisation's main communication system.
exercises.zh: 這項政策是在電子郵件成為機構主要通訊系統前制定的。
exercises.upgrade: The policy was written before electronic mail became the organisation's main communication system.

options.explanation: formal system-level meaning of email，electronic mail 是最精準完整形式。
letter 是書信類型，不是電子郵件系統。
text message 是另一種通訊系統。
inbox 只是收件位置。
attachment 是隨訊息傳送的檔案。
email address 是郵箱識別地址，不是通訊系統。

exercises.original: The company introduced email across all departments in the 1990s.
exercises.zh: 公司在九十年代於所有部門引入電子郵件。
exercises.upgrade: The company introduced electronic mail across all departments in the 1990s.

options.explanation: historical/organisational introduction of the medium 適合正式 full form。
mailing list 只是群發機制。
notification 是提示，不是整個郵件系統。
letter 是紙本／書信概念。
inbox 是收件箱。
instant message 是聊天型即時訊息。

exercises.original: Staff were trained to use email securely.
exercises.zh: 員工接受培訓，以安全使用電子郵件。
exercises.upgrade: Staff were trained to use electronic mail securely.

options.explanation: use securely 指整個 email communication system，electronic mail 合適。
attachment 只是其中的檔案。
email address 只是帳戶識別。
notification 是提示。
letter 不是電子系統。
text message 是另一通訊方式。

words.example: I received an email message confirming the booking.
words.exampleZh: 我收到一封確認預約的電郵。

exercises.original: I received an email confirming the booking.
exercises.zh: 我收到一封確認預約的電郵。
exercises.upgrade: I received an email message confirming the booking.

options.explanation: received + confirming booking 表示一封具體可讀的電郵訊息。
email address 不能被『收到』作為確認內容。
attachment 可能包含文件，但不是整封訊息。
inbox 是訊息所在的位置。
mailing list 是收件人群組／分發機制。
notification 可能提示有新郵件，但不是這封確認電郵本身。

exercises.original: Please forward the email to the finance team.
exercises.zh: 請把這封電郵轉寄給財務團隊。
exercises.upgrade: Please forward the email message to the finance team.

options.explanation: forward 明確作用於一封具體訊息。
attachment only 只會轉寄檔案，不能涵蓋郵件正文。
email address 是收件資訊，不是被轉寄的內容。
inbox 不能整個作為單一訊息轉寄。
letter necessarily 會錯把渠道改成紙本／書信。
notification 不是原郵件內容。

exercises.original: The email included the revised meeting time.
exercises.zh: 這封電郵包含修訂後的會議時間。
exercises.upgrade: The email message included the revised meeting time.

options.explanation: included content 表示具體訊息正文。
attachment 是可附加內容，但原句說資訊在電郵中。
inbox 是儲存位置。
email address 不承載完整正文資訊。
mailing list 是分發對象。
text message 是另一傳送渠道。

words.meaning: 電子通訊往來；電子函件往來
words.example: All electronic correspondence relating to the case must be retained.
words.exampleZh: 所有與該個案有關的電子通訊往來都必須保存。

exercises.original: All email relating to the case must be retained for seven years.
exercises.zh: 所有與個案有關的電子通訊往來須保存七年。
exercises.upgrade: All electronic correspondence relating to the case must be retained for seven years.

options.explanation: all relating to the case + retained 表示正式、持續的書面往來紀錄。
notifications 只是一類提示，不能涵蓋所有 case correspondence。
attachments only 只涵蓋附檔，遺漏正文。
email addresses 是聯絡資訊。
inboxes 是儲存位置，不是 correspondence 本身。
instant messages only 會把渠道錯誤縮窄成聊天平台。

exercises.original: The lawyer reviewed the email exchanged with the client.
exercises.zh: 律師審閱了與客戶之間的電子函件往來。
exercises.upgrade: The lawyer reviewed the electronic correspondence exchanged with the client.

options.explanation: exchanged with the client 表示多封正式往來，correspondence 比單一 message 更準。
mailing list 不是客戶往來內容。
notifications 不是完整函件交流。
inbox 只是存放位置。
attachments only 不含正文。
email addresses 只是雙方地址。

exercises.original: The audit covered email between the office and the supplier.
exercises.zh: 審計涵蓋辦公室與供應商之間的電子通訊往來。
exercises.upgrade: The audit covered electronic correspondence between the office and the supplier.

options.explanation: between two organisations + audit 指正式往來紀錄。
text messages only 只是另一渠道，不能代表 email archive。
notifications 不是完整 correspondence。
mailing list 是群發名單／機制。
inboxes 是容器。
email addresses 不是實際通訊內容。

words.meaning: 數碼函件往來；數碼書面通訊
words.example: The office moved most of its routine correspondence to digital channels.
words.exampleZh: 辦公室把大部分日常函件往來轉到數碼渠道。

exercises.original: The office has moved most routine email away from paper records.
exercises.zh: 辦公室已把大部分日常函件往來由紙本轉為數碼。
exercises.upgrade: The office has moved most routine correspondence to digital channels.

options.explanation: paper vs digital 對比是 digital correspondence 的核心語境。
paper letters 正是被替代的紙本形式。
inbox 只是數碼存放位置。
attachment 是一個檔案。
notification 是提醒。
email address 是聯絡識別。

exercises.original: The archive includes both paper letters and email.
exercises.zh: 檔案庫同時收錄紙本信件和數碼函件往來。
exercises.upgrade: The archive includes both paper letters and digital correspondence.

options.explanation: 與 paper letters 對比時，digital correspondence 清楚表示數碼書面往來。
inboxes 是儲存資料夾，不是往來內容。
attachments 只是部分內容。
notifications 不是完整函件。
mailing lists 是分發工具。
email addresses 是地址資料。

exercises.original: The records policy applies equally to paper and email communication.
exercises.zh: 紀錄政策同樣適用於紙本和數碼書面通訊。
exercises.upgrade: The records policy applies equally to paper and digital correspondence.

options.explanation: records policy + paper contrast 支持 formal digital correspondence。
instant messaging only 只是數碼通訊的一種，太窄。
inbox 不是通信內容。
notification 只是提示。
attachment 不是整體往來。
email address 不是訊息。

words.meaning: 網上訊息傳遞；網上通訊
words.example: The support team uses email and other forms of online messaging to contact customers.
words.exampleZh: 支援團隊使用電郵及其他網上通訊方式聯絡顧客。

exercises.original: The support team uses email and other online channels to contact customers.
exercises.zh: 支援團隊使用電郵及其他網上通訊方式聯絡顧客。
exercises.upgrade: The support team uses email and other forms of online messaging to contact customers.

options.explanation: email is being grouped with other online message channels，online messaging 作上位類別自然。
letter 通常不是 online channel。
inbox 是收件位置。
attachment 是檔案。
email address 是地址。
mailing list only 只是群發機制，不能涵蓋其他 messaging channels。

exercises.original: Customers can contact us by email or other online messages.
exercises.zh: 顧客可透過電郵或其他網上訊息聯絡我們。
exercises.upgrade: Customers can contact us by email or other forms of online messaging.

options.explanation: other forms 明確要求一個更廣的線上訊息類別。
postal mail 不是 online messaging。
inbox 不是傳送方式。
notification only 只是其中一種提示形式。
attachment 不能單獨構成通訊渠道。
email address 是識別資料。

exercises.original: The company combines email with chat in its online communication strategy.
exercises.zh: 公司在網上通訊策略中結合電郵與聊天功能。
exercises.upgrade: The company combines email with chat as forms of online messaging.

options.explanation: email + chat 同屬 broader online messaging category。
letters 不是必然在線。
attachments 是內容元件。
email addresses 不是 message forms。
inboxes 是收件位置。
notifications only 不能涵蓋 chat 和 email。

words.example: I reviewed our correspondence with the supplier before the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 會議前，我重看了我們與供應商之間的通信往來。

exercises.original: I reviewed our email with the supplier before the meeting.
exercises.zh: 會議前，我重看了我們與供應商之間的通信往來。
exercises.upgrade: I reviewed our correspondence with the supplier before the meeting.

options.explanation: our ... with supplier 表示整段雙方書面往來，correspondence 最自然。
inbox 是儲存郵件的地方，不是往來本身。
email address 只是聯絡地址。
attachment 只是單一檔案。
notification 是提醒。
text message 是一種單獨訊息渠道，不能涵蓋整段 email exchange。

exercises.original: The company keeps a record of all email with major clients.
exercises.zh: 公司保存與主要客戶的所有通信紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: The company keeps a record of all correspondence with major clients.

options.explanation: all ... with clients 表示長期書面交流。
mailing lists 是分發工具。
inboxes 只是儲存位置。
attachments 不涵蓋正文。
email addresses 是聯絡資料。
notifications 是提示。

exercises.original: Her email with the university continued for several months.
exercises.zh: 她與大學的通信往來持續數月。
exercises.upgrade: Her correspondence with the university continued for several months.

options.explanation: continued for several months 表示持續書面往來，correspondence 正確。
attachment exchange only 太窄，未涵蓋郵件內容。
email address 不是交流。
inbox 不會『持續數月』。
notification 不是持續通信。
instant message 會錯換渠道。

words.example: I sent her a message confirming the new time.
words.exampleZh: 我傳了一則訊息給她，確認新的時間。

exercises.original: I sent her an email confirming the new time.
exercises.zh: 我傳了一則訊息給她，確認新的時間。
exercises.upgrade: I sent her a message confirming the new time.

options.explanation: channel is not important; one concrete communication can naturally be called a message。
inbox 是訊息存放位置。
email address 是收件識別。
attachment 是附帶檔案。
mailing list 是多收件人分發機制。
notification 是提示，不一定包含完整確認內容。

exercises.original: Please reply to my email when you have the figures.
exercises.zh: 有數字後請回覆我的訊息。
exercises.upgrade: Please reply to my message when you have the figures.

options.explanation: reply to a concrete communication 可自然說 reply to my message。
email address 不能被回覆。
inbox 不能作單一回覆對象。
attachment 可以回覆附檔相關內容，但不是原訊息本身。
notification 通常不需作為原內容回覆。
mailing list 是分發機制。

exercises.original: Her email explained why the delivery was late.
exercises.zh: 她的訊息解釋了送貨延誤的原因。
exercises.upgrade: Her message explained why the delivery was late.

options.explanation: one email carrying explanatory content 可用 generic message。
attachment 不一定包含正文解釋。
email address 不能解釋原因。
inbox 是位置。
mailing list 不是內容。
notification 通常只提醒，不等於完整說明。

words.example: Please confirm the arrangement in written communication.
words.exampleZh: 請以書面形式確認這項安排。

exercises.original: Please confirm the arrangement by email rather than only by phone.
exercises.zh: 請以書面形式確認安排，而不要只用電話。
exercises.upgrade: Please confirm the arrangement in written communication rather than only by phone.

options.explanation: email vs phone 對比的核心是 written vs spoken record。
notification 只是提示。
inbox 不是 communication form。
attachment 是檔案，不是整體書面確認。
email address 是地址。
instant message necessarily 會把媒介錯誤限制到聊天平台。

exercises.original: The company requires important decisions to be confirmed by email.
exercises.zh: 公司要求重要決定以書面通訊確認。
exercises.upgrade: The company requires important decisions to be confirmed in written communication.

options.explanation: confirmed in writing 是政策重點，email 只是其中一種書面渠道。
inbox 不能確認決定。
attachment 可能是文件，但不是 communication 本身。
mailing list 是分發工具。
notification 只是提醒。
email address 不是書面內容。

exercises.original: Email provides a written record of the instruction.
exercises.zh: 電郵為該指示提供書面紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: Written communication provides a record of the instruction.

options.explanation: written record 是這裡的核心功能，適合上位詞 written communication。
email address 沒有指示內容。
inbox 只是存放位置。
notification 未必包含完整指示。
attachment only 太窄。
text message only 是另一具體渠道。

words.example: The company prefers email communication for routine requests.
words.exampleZh: 公司較常以電郵處理日常要求。

exercises.original: The company prefers email for routine customer requests.
exercises.zh: 公司較常以電郵處理日常顧客要求。
exercises.upgrade: The company prefers email communication for routine customer requests.

options.explanation: preference for a channel/workflow rather than one message，email communication 最自然。
mailing list 只處理群發。
inbox 是收件位置。
attachment 是檔案。
email address 是識別資料。
notification 不是完整客戶溝通渠道。

exercises.original: Good email is important when teams work remotely.
exercises.zh: 團隊遙距工作時，良好的電郵溝通很重要。
exercises.upgrade: Good email communication is important when teams work remotely.

options.explanation: good communication practice via email 是整體溝通活動。
email address 只提供聯絡點。
inbox management only 是個人整理習慣，不等於 communication quality。
attachments 只是部分內容。
notifications 不足以涵蓋團隊交流。
mailing list 只是其中一種發送方式。

exercises.original: The policy sets standards for email with clients.
exercises.zh: 政策訂立與客戶電郵溝通的標準。
exercises.upgrade: The policy sets standards for email communication with clients.

options.explanation: standards for communication with clients 表示一種工作渠道和行為規範。
attachments only 過窄。
email addresses 不是溝通行為。
inboxes 是系統位置。
notifications 只是提示。
letters only 把渠道改為傳統書信。

words.meaning: 商業函件；商務通訊往來
words.example: The course teaches students how to write clear business correspondence.
words.exampleZh: 課程教授學生如何撰寫清晰的商務函件。

exercises.original: The course teaches students how to write professional email to clients.
exercises.zh: 課程教授學生如何撰寫專業的商務函件。
exercises.upgrade: The course teaches students how to write clear business correspondence.

options.explanation: professional + clients 指商務書面往來，business correspondence 最精準。
text messages 通常較即時、非正式，不等於商務函件總類。
notifications 不是完整商務交流。
email addresses 是聯絡資料。
attachments 是隨函文件。
inboxes 是儲存位置。

exercises.original: Her job involves a large amount of email with suppliers and customers.
exercises.zh: 她的工作涉及大量與供應商及顧客的商務通訊。
exercises.upgrade: Her job involves a large amount of business correspondence with suppliers and customers.

options.explanation: suppliers/customers + job 表示專業商務往來。
mailing lists 只是群發工具。
inboxes 不是往來內容。
attachments 只是部分。
notifications 不是正式對話。
personal messages 與 business context 不合。

exercises.original: The manager reviewed the email before sending it to the client.
exercises.zh: 經理在寄給客戶前審閱商務函件。
exercises.upgrade: The manager reviewed the business correspondence before sending it to the client.

options.explanation: client-facing professional writing 可歸入 business correspondence。
notification 只是提示。
inbox 不是被寄出的內容。
email address 只是收件資料。
attachment only 不能涵蓋正文。
instant message 是另一較即時渠道。

words.meaning: 網上函件往來；網上通信
words.example: Most of the course administration is handled through online correspondence.
words.exampleZh: 課程大部分行政工作都透過網上通信處理。

exercises.original: Most course administration is handled by email.
exercises.zh: 課程大部分行政工作都透過網上通信處理。
exercises.upgrade: Most course administration is handled through online correspondence.

options.explanation: course administration + remote written exchange 可自然概括為 online correspondence。
postal letters only 和 online 明顯相反。
inbox 是存放位置。
email address 是地址。
attachment 是檔案。
notification 是提示。

exercises.original: The service keeps records of email with users.
exercises.zh: 服務保留與使用者網上函件往來的紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: The service keeps records of online correspondence with users.

options.explanation: records of exchanges with users 表示 online written correspondence。
inboxes 是容器。
email addresses 是識別資訊。
attachments 只是一部分。
notifications 不涵蓋完整往來。
postal mail only 不是 online。

exercises.original: Remote staff rely heavily on email for formal exchanges.
exercises.zh: 遙距員工高度依賴網上函件往來作正式交流。
exercises.upgrade: Remote staff rely heavily on online correspondence for formal exchanges.

options.explanation: remote + formal exchanges 支持 broad online correspondence。
instant messages only 過度縮窄。
inboxes 不是交流。
attachments 不等於交流。
notifications 只是提醒。
mailing lists only 只是一種群發方式。

words.meaning: 郵件；電郵（電腦／非正式語境）
words.example: Check your mail for the confirmation link.
words.exampleZh: 請查看電郵，找出確認連結。

exercises.original: Check your email for the confirmation link.
exercises.zh: 請查看電郵，找出確認連結。
exercises.upgrade: Check your mail for the confirmation link.

options.explanation: computing/informal context 下 check your mail 自然表示查看電郵。
inbox only 是位置；句子要讀其中收到的郵件。
email address 是地址。
attachment 可能沒有確認連結。
notification 只提示有訊息。
letter 會被理解為紙本信件。

exercises.original: The app lets you read email on your phone.
exercises.zh: 這個應用程式讓你在手機讀取電郵。
exercises.upgrade: The app lets you read mail on your phone.

options.explanation: app/computing context makes mail a natural shorthand for email。
mailing list 是群發名單。
email address 不能被『讀取』作訊息內容。
attachment only 過窄。
notification 只是提示。
postal letter 不會通常透過 mail app 閱讀。

exercises.original: The server stores incoming email until users download it.
exercises.zh: 伺服器儲存收到的電郵，直至使用者下載。
exercises.upgrade: The server stores incoming mail until users download it.

options.explanation: server + incoming mail 是標準 computing/email collocation。
email addresses 是帳戶識別。
attachments only 不是所有 incoming mail。
notifications 是系統提醒。
letters 是紙本郵件。
mailing list 是分發機制。

words.example: The policy treats email as a form of written electronic communication.
words.exampleZh: 政策把電郵視為一種電子書面通訊。

exercises.original: The policy treats email as a formal written record.
exercises.zh: 政策把電郵視為正式電子書面通訊紀錄。
exercises.upgrade: The policy treats email as a form of written electronic communication.

options.explanation: policy definition requires a transparent channel-neutral description，written electronic communication 合適。
notification 只是某類提示。
email address 不是 communication content。
inbox 是儲存位置。
attachment 只是檔案。
instant message only 過度限制到另一特定渠道。

exercises.original: Email is one type of written message sent electronically.
exercises.zh: 電郵是一種電子傳送的書面通訊。
exercises.upgrade: Email is a form of written electronic communication.

options.explanation: the sentence itself defines email by written + electronic transmission。
mailing list 是分發機制，不是通訊類別。
email address 是地址。
notification 是提示。
attachment 是附檔。
inbox 是收件位置。

exercises.original: For compliance purposes, email counts as written communication sent electronically.
exercises.zh: 在合規用途上，電郵被視為電子書面通訊。
exercises.upgrade: For compliance purposes, email counts as written electronic communication.

options.explanation: compliance context benefits from an explicit descriptive category。
inbox 不能作為 communication 本身。
attachment 只是部分內容。
email address 不承載完整訊息。
mailing list 是收件分發機制。
notification 只是提醒，不等於正式書面交流。

falseSynonyms.zh: 信件不等於 email letter 傳統上指紙本或正式書信；email 是電子傳送的訊息。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A letter may be sent by post; an email is electronic.

falseSynonyms.zh: 手機短訊不等於 email text message 通常指 SMS 或手機訊息；傳送系統、格式和慣例都不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Text messages and emails use different communication systems.

falseSynonyms.zh: 即時訊息不等於 email instant message 通常透過聊天平台即時交換；email 是非同步郵件系統。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Instant messaging is conversational and platform-based; email is mailbox-based.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通知不等於 email notification 是提示或警示；它可以由 email 發出，但也可以是 App 推送或系統提示。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A notification is an alert, not necessarily an email message.

falseSynonyms.zh: 收件箱不等於 email inbox 是儲存收到訊息的位置；email 是訊息或通訊媒介。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An inbox contains emails; it is not an email itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 附件不等於 email attachment 是隨電郵傳送的檔案；不是整封電郵。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An attachment is a file sent with an email.

falseSynonyms.zh: 郵寄名單／電郵群組不等於 email mailing list 是收件人名單或群發機制；email 是被傳送的訊息。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A mailing list distributes messages; it is not the message itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 電郵地址不等於 email email address 是識別收件人的地址；不是訊息內容。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An email address identifies a mailbox; an email is a message or medium.
